text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... ha...! Fufu... 
Heheheheheh...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaaahahahaha!! Yes, this is it...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"The thing that fulfills me!! 
Ahahahaaaah... No more—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I won't give it up!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Wha...!? What in the world is that... —Is 
she really an Umamusume!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, no good...! —I have to run away, 
or I'll be swallowed up...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fear... anguish... sweet despair... Hurl 
them all at me! Give me—... EVERYTHING!!!!

—Hanshin Racecourse was enveloped in 
bewilderment. Witnessing the Triple Tiara 
Umamusume who had fully awakened...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Wha... What...? What... just 
happened...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She had a weird kind of intensity, but... 
still... it wasn't this extreme. At this 
rate, she's practically—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: —A monster...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Mmm...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: That was so delicious... ♡

"I raised my voice to cut through the din. 
Normally, she would come to her senses 
immediately—yet she remained consumed by 
raw instinct."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Where should we go next, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Fufufufufu...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...What do you mean, where?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: The next race.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I wanna compete against someone even 
stronger. Ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You worry too much. Though, that part of 
you is... lovely, too...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You want to see more of my running too, 
don't you? I know you do...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, you're too far away over there. 
Come over here.”

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Up to. Here.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Come here

In that instant—my consciousness snapped 
and went dark.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Just a little longer... We'll finally be 
all alone together.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No one will get in our way anymore. I 
won't let anyone tear us apart...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Finally, we can be the same...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"All that's left—is for you to change. 
Together, let us savor... absolute 
ecstasy."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Come now... won't you?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: C o m e o v e r h e r e

âI squint at the dazzling light. Nursing 
a throbbing headache, I timidly lift 
myself up...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I am terribly sorry, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Are you feeling all right? You haven't 
been doing well lately as it is... And 
now, because of me...

It's a relief. Right now, she's... just 
the same Still in Love as always.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I am truly sorry. ...However.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"To put on such a strong run against 
opponents of that caliber. Splendid..."

Watching her smile contentedly, I felt a 
slight sense of unease. There really was 
something...—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Summer will soon be upon us. And there, 
once more, I shall be reborn—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to aim for the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup, where I put on such an unworthy 
performance last year.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The pride of a Triple Tiara Umamusume that 
you were so proud of... Now is the time to 
show it...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"—Is the Queen Elizabeth II Cup alright 
with you?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Then... it's settled.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Please wait just a moment. I will bring 
some tea.

happening within her as well. I should 
stop and think—
